title: Supported etale generators for cohomological support filtrations
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a scheme with a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Use the unbounded ordinary small etale derived category $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $(\Phi^a)_{a\in\mathbf Z}$ be subsets of $|X|$, each stable under specialization, with $\Phi^{a+1}\subseteq\Phi^a$ and $\Phi^a=|X|$ for every $a\leq b$, for some integer $b$. For a sheaf $F$, its support is the set of points with nonzero geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Choose a small skeleton of affine etale $X$-schemes $u:V\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each closed reduced subscheme $i:Z\hookrightarrow V$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $u(|Z|)\subseteq\Phi^a$, put $G_{V,Z,a}=u_!i_*\Lambda_Z[-a]$. Here $\Lambda_Z$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], $i_*$ is closed direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and $u_!$ is the exact left adjoint to etale restriction, equivalently the sheafified sum over lifts to $V$, as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian]. The full subcategory
$$\mathcal U_\Phi=\{K:\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^a(K)\subseteq\Phi^a\text{ for every }a\}$$
is the smallest strictly full subcategory containing all $G_{V,Z,a}$ and zero and closed under small coproducts, direct summands, $[1]$, and extensions. No constructibility or finite-dimensionality hypothesis on $X$ is imposed.

source.place: XVII 5.2, support half of Gabber's construction: agent-formulated supported-generator input. The unrestricted generators are stated in lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-grothendieck-abelian; the additional filtered-support assertion is a separate obligation. Full Gabber proof source WANTED in report.md.
